description: Exact HPO frequencies with binomial confidence intervals for IDDALDS
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import beta
rows=[];hdr=None
with requests.get("https://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/hp/hpoa/phenotype.hpoa",stream=True,timeout=180) as r:
    for raw in r.iter_lines():
        line=raw.decode("utf-8","ignore")
        if not line or line.startswith("#"): continue
        if hdr is None: hdr=line.split("\t"); continue
        if line.startswith("OMIM:618906"): rows.append(line.split("\t"))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=hdr)
print("rows:",len(df))
print(df[["hpo_id","frequency","reference","evidence"]].to_string(index=False))

def parse(f):
    if isinstance(f,str) and "/" in f:
        a,b=f.split("/"); return int(a),int(b)
    return np.nan,np.nan
df[["k","n"]]=df.frequency.apply(lambda f:pd.Series(parse(f)))
d=df.dropna(subset=["k"]).copy()
d["p"]=d.k/d.n
d["lo"]=[beta.ppf(.025,k+0.5,n-k+0.5) for k,n in zip(d.k,d.n)]
d["hi"]=[beta.ppf(.975,k+0.5,n-k+0.5) for k,n in zip(d.k,d.n)]
nmj=requests.get("https://ontology.jax.org/api/network/annotation/OMIM:618906",timeout=45).json()["categories"]
nm={x["id"]:x["name"] for c in nmj.values() for x in c}
d["name"]=d.hpo_id.map(nm).fillna(d.hpo_id)
d=d.sort_values("p")
print("\nannotated with explicit n/N:",len(d))
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5,6))
y=np.arange(len(d))
ax.errorbar(d.p*100,y,xerr=[(d.p-d.lo)*100,(d.hi-d.p)*100],fmt="o",color="#2c3e50",ecolor="#95a5a6",capsize=3)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(["%s (%d/%d)"%(n,k,nn) for n,k,nn in zip(d.name,d.k,d.n)],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("frequency among annotated IDDALDS patients (%), 95% exact CI")
ax.set_xlim(0,105); ax.axvline(50,ls=":",c="#bdc3c7")
ax.set_title("IDDALDS (OMIM:618906, TANC2) phenotype frequencies",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
